g.text: How the AI voice gets onto a WhatsApp call (and into Google Meet)
Follow the numbers 1 to 8. Line colour tells you what kind of connection it is (key at the bottom).

g.text: talks to Chrome over CDP (Chrome DevTools
Protocol), a local connection on port 9222
- WhatsApp: checks the page every 0.5 s for an
Accept button, clicks it, notices when call ends
- Meet: clicks Join, turns on captions, reads
captions (who said what) + chat, types tips

g.text: whatever we play here, they hear

g.text: records both sides of the call,
sends the caller's voice to the AI,
plays the AI's voice into the fake mic,
cuts the AI off if the caller interrupts
E0 fake caller, to test without a phone
E2 look things up mid-call (file search,
E4 Maya: speaks only when her name is said
E5 plays audio files / a generated podcast

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(230, 81, 0), rgb(251, 123, 53));

g.text: one model that listens AND speaks
live both ways: caller audio in, AI voice out
replies about 1.3 s after the caller stops
